headline: Stringouts from any bin, retimed clips at a glance, and a tidier Filters menu.
notes: Media, Used 2+, Offline, Archived only, Used again, Hidden, Imported twice, Empty bins and Sequence filter each have their icon under "On the panel"
A selected bin is labelled BIN, not NO FILE, and no longer shows the last clip's numbers
In the sequence view, Select all sits at the bottom right like every other view
The BIN label is blue, a colour no other label uses
Fixed: in a bin, clips that are never used now show their VIDEO / AUDIO / STILL tag
Fixed: pressing a filter while a bin was selected emptied the list
The Project view's filters no longer show over a bin, where they do nothing
A bin's clips are listed like the sequence view's, and their names line up whether or not they have a colour label
The Media filter (All, Video, Audio, Stills) works in a bin, and can be pinned there like anywhere else
The About window shows the logo beside the Trace+ name, as in the panel, and is one line shorter
Fixed: with Detail set to Clean, a bin showed only its folder headings and none of its clips
A bin with folders inside opens as a list of folders with their counts – press one to open it
On Windows, hints now say Ctrl instead of ⌘, and copied scan reports keep their line breaks
Fixed: 2 overlapping edits could release each other's lock early
The search box in Filters has more room around it
In a bin, In this cut and Not in this cut are 2 big counts like the clip view, with Build a stringout underneath
Build a stringout works from In this cut too, so you can lay out the clips a cut already uses
Every action button now has an icon beside its words, including Remove spare copies, Select all and Next cut
In a bin, Build a stringout is dark like the counts above it and turns purple when you point at it
The header no longer says BETA
The licence card now points to ☰ > Help & licence, the menu item's real name
In Imported twice, an item that covers a different part of the same file is now labelled "other part"
The unused parts of a clip no longer repeat their total in a line under the panes, which already show it
In Filters, each line under "On the panel" shows an unpin symbol, and it turns yellow when you point at it
New: a use that plays at another speed shows it in an amber tag (50%, 200%), or REV when it plays backwards
New: Retimed, beside Repeat and Other, narrows a clip's uses to the ones that are retimed
New: in the Active cut view, each clip's row shows its speed too – 200% when every use plays at one speed, "1 at 50%" when only some do
New: a Retimed filter in the Active cut view lists only the clips with a use at another speed
Fixed: in the Active cut view, Mark and Export now act only on the clips your filters leave on screen
Fixed: a bin stays on screen when you cut one of its clips into the timeline
Fixed: Mark and Export could act on the clip you had selected before the current one
Fixed: trimming the last clip on a track is picked up straight away, and an edit made during a scan is no longer missed
Fixed: the clear button also clears ticked files in the Project view, and leaves your timeline selection alone there
Fixed: Move, Put back and colour labels act only on the ticked rows you can see
Fixed: ticks no longer carry over to the next clip you select
Fixed: Copy list copies exactly what is on screen, in the clip view and the Active cut view
Fixed: the percentages in the Active cut export on sequences that start at 01:00:00:00
The Move button's bin arrow is the right size, and long bin names shorten neatly
The Filters menu fits a narrow panel
The tour waits until Trace+ is activated, and now shows what a bin can do
A VersionUp key pasted into Trace+ now says so

Help & licence (renamed from Help and licence) checks for updates every time it opens and says the answer under the version: up to date, a newer version to download, or that it could not check. Check for updates has left the ☰ menu
Fixed: Check for updates said you had the latest version when it could not reach the update server
Help & licence has a Check for updates button above Help guide and Close – the answer appears right there, with What's new or Try again
Clearer messages when a search or filter empties the list, and while a new clip is being checked
